nativeValidation.setup: Run the repository-root PowerShell setup and non-elevated fixture command on the normal validation account. The account needs no symbolic-link, protected-path ACL, service-control, DiskPart, or Hyper-V privilege for the fixtures.
expectedResults: The worker revision is abbf5d729de59f1d7f84d0adb9ba13e4ac3bef58. Record the actual SHA from the checkout used on Windows.

Non-elevated fixtures pass five times. Running and transient first results keep VM.Exited open. A later stopped or absent result releases VM.Exited and watchDone. Callback-only waiting makes zero queries. A blocked query preserves prompt callback, closure, and cancellation behavior. Stop and image-build fixtures preserve unconfirmed-stop safeguards.

Elevated probe passes. Native HCS reports the VM running after the injected disconnect. After direct native termination with callbacks withheld, a native HCS retry closes the VM and watcher signals, and the sandbox manager emits FAILED / LOST_ON_DEVICE for the test VM.

elevatedOnly.setup: Use an isolated Hyper-V-enabled Windows amd64 host and elevated PowerShell. Ensure there are no existing OwnSand compute systems, make a writable disposable copy of the Linux kernel and rootfs image fixtures, and point OWNSAND_HV_TEST_KERNEL and OWNSAND_HV_TEST_ROOTFS at them. See the image requirements in integration_windows_test.go. Run these commands after copying the probe source. This probe injects a disconnect for one VM and withholds its exit callback while running real HCS queries and termination.
commands: if (-not $env:OWNSAND_HV_TEST_KERNEL -or -not $env:OWNSAND_HV_TEST_ROOTFS -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:OWNSAND_HV_TEST_KERNEL -PathType Leaf) -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:OWNSAND_HV_TEST_ROOTFS -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Set OWNSAND_HV_TEST_KERNEL and OWNSAND_HV_TEST_ROOTFS to existing isolated Linux image fixtures' }
expectedResults: Elevated probe passes. Native HCS reports the VM running after the injected disconnect. After direct native termination with callbacks withheld, a native HCS retry closes the VM and watcher signals, and the sandbox manager emits FAILED / LOST_ON_DEVICE for the test VM.
elevatedOnly.blocker: The configured native account is non-elevated. It cannot boot or terminate Hyper-V VMs or apply the VM file ACLs.
